_status: Piano Analytics has NO fixed reporting schema: properties (dimensions) and metrics are per-site Data Model keys. The committed catalog is the STANDARD BASELINE (research dossier Annex A: 45 explicit metrics; Annex B: 103 standard property keys = 148 fields). Per-site CUSTOM keys are resolved live (field_discovery.mode=dynamic). This is the GA4-custom-dimension situation, more extreme (no static universal list exists by construction).
_disambiguation: Target = Piano ANALYTICS (web/app analytics, GA4-equivalent), host https://api.atinternet.io/v3/data/. NOT Piano ID / Composer / VX / Activation (subscription/paywall/identity, api.piano.io, different APIs).

_derivation.note: official_fields.json is produced by build_official_fields.py (committed alongside, deterministic, no network/clock). There is NO metadata endpoint in the v3 Data API to list a site's properties/metrics (docs point to the Data Model UI; the third-party python wrapper only calls getData/getRowCount/getTotal). official_fields.json is therefore the STANDARD baseline authored from Piano standard-tagging docs, with section/tier enrichment cross-read from the Supermetrics catalog. Metrics use the m_-prefixed key (m_visits); properties use the bare key (device_type). Custom/site-defined keys are NOT emitted into the committed catalog -- they are resolved per site at use and validated live (unknown key -> 400 -> invalid_request / pull_invalid_request drift).
_derivation.dynamic_catalog_rule: field_discovery.mode = 'dynamic'. Completeness is proven by: (1) the baseline is exhaustively enumerated; (2) the connector's columns param is fully general (any Data Model key is expressible); (3) unknown keys fail loud. No list is ever truncated; no unknown key is silently dropped.
_derivation.unit_rule: Units are driven by the catalogued physical_type (integer/decimal), NEVER by an id suffix (google-ads 26.2 review lesson). Ratio metrics (physical_type decimal, e.g. m_bounce_rate) land raw at day grain and are recomputed at the semantic layer.
_derivation.count_divergence: Supermetrics publishes 48 metrics / 162 dimensions under a 'performance__' internal namespace (strip it to recover the Piano key family). Their metric/dimension count is a FLOOR that includes per-source permutations and deprecated/system fields; the committed baseline transcribes the dossier's explicitly-enumerated Annex A+B keys (45 explicit metrics + 103 standard property keys = 148 fields -- NO round-number padding). A real site with custom properties EXCEEDS this floor; those are resolved live (dynamic). The honest formula: 45 explicit metrics + a live-resolved dynamic surface, never a fabricated round total.

_also._note: getData / getRowCount / getTotal, all synchronous, host https://api.atinternet.io/v3/data/ . No getStructure/metadata method exists.
Verbatim body: {columns:[...], sort:[...], space:{s:[<site_id>]}, period:{p1:[{type:D,start,end}]}, max-results, page-num}
DataFeed[] -> {Context, Columns, Rows, totals, references}. The per-query Columns echo carries label+type for harvested enrichment.
200+ codes, API-Code string (Category_Subcode) + HTTP status + message. The unknown-column code is the InvalidColumns_* family -> pull_invalid_request drift.

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/piano-analytics-at-internet-fields.md -o server/modules/piano/catalog_sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT (enrichment snapshot only). 48 metrics / 162 dimensions under a 'performance__' prefix; provenance-only in v1 (descriptions authored in build_official_fields.py, so no 'file'/'parser' keys here).

non_additive_metrics._note: Visit/visitor-scoped metrics do NOT sum across property breakdowns (Piano 'Why can't we sum visits on page analyses?'). Marked non_additive at the catalog (via build_official_fields.py); use getTotal for true totals; marts must not UNPIVOT-and-sum these across breakdowns.

probe.structural_note: getData POST over a 1-day window on the selected site: batch up to ~10 candidate columns (properties or metrics) alongside a single known core metric (m_visits) as {"columns":[...],"space":{"s":[<site_id>]},"period":{"p1":[{"type":"D","start":D-1,"end":D-1}]},"max-results":1}. A batch that returns a 400 InvalidColumns_* is bisected so the exact rejected key is captured (never the whole batch). 509 QuotasExceeded pauses+resumes the SAME batch (breaker-aware, serialized per key -- NO parallel fan-out). A sort key must also be in columns. This probe both ratifies the baseline and DERIVES the live per-site catalog for a connected site.

field_discovery.baseline_source: Piano standard-tagging Data Model (research dossier Annexes A+B; Supermetrics enrichment 48 m / 162 d floor)
field_discovery.per_site_note: Custom properties/metrics are site-defined; the getData columns param accepts any Data Model key and validates it live (unknown -> 400 invalid_request -> pull_invalid_request drift). No per-site key is invented into the committed catalog. A confirmed Data Model admin/management endpoint (SPIKE -- not documented in the reachable developer portal) would upgrade this to full programmatic per-site generation (see ROLLOUT_NOTES).

period._note: period object keyed p1 (p2.. for comparisons). Absolute: {type:D,start:YYYY-MM-DD,end:YYYY-MM-DD}. Relative: {type:R,granularity:D|M|Q|Y|H,startOffset:-1,endOffset:-1}. Timezone = site's; multi-site uses the most-easterly requested site's TZ.
period.retention_note: Historical backfill bounded by the client's Piano contract (typically 25-38 months); exceeding raises a RetentionMonths_* class 400.

space._note: space = {"s":[<site_id>,...]} -- the reporting-entity selector. site_id is an integer per measurement perimeter.

_request_limits._note: Module-local companion consumed by connector.py at request-build time (validated BEFORE the API call; violations raise typed invalid_request without a provider round-trip).
_request_limits._source: POST /v3/data/getData endpoint description + method limits, Data Query API v3

getdata_default._note: Retention is contract-bound (typically 25-38 months ~ 1155 days at 38 months). A window exceeding the contract raises a RetentionMonths_* 400 live; the pre-call bound is a conservative ceiling, not a hard provider promise.

_request_limits.paging: getRowCount to plan, loop page-num with max-results=10000 until short page or 200k ceiling; log truncation (never silent). Chunk a >50-column selection into multiple getData calls sharing dimension keys + stable sort, merge on the (period, property-tuple) grain key.

excluded_sections.AV INSIGHTS - QOS DELIVERY: QoS delivery metrics require AV (audio/video) tagging that a non-media site does not emit; excluded from default profiles until an AV profile exists (zero rows otherwise, honest degrade).
excluded_sections.CONTENT - MV TESTING: Multivariate-testing dimensions only populated on sites running Piano MV tests; excluded from default profiles.
excluded_sections.AUDIENCE - PRIVACY: Consent-mode metrics depend on the client's consent tagging; excluded from the core profile (present as advanced).

_exposure_note: exposure = reachable through the profiles' getData columns. Under catalog_driven, every baseline field is exposed EXCEPT the excluded_sections families (which need AV/MV/consent tagging). Per-site CUSTOM keys are never in the committed catalog (dynamic, validated live). Non-additive metrics carry non_additive:true and are never blindly summed across breakdowns (semantic layer / getTotal).

_auth_and_quota.credential_note: Access key + secret key, from platform env PIANO_ACCESS_KEY / PIANO_SECRET_KEY (NEVER manifest). The x-api-key header value is <access>_<secret>. Key inherits the creating user's site permissions. Used immediately as a header, never logged (AD-3).
_auth_and_quota.rate_limiting: Concurrency-throttled. QuotasExceeded_TooManyRequests -> HTTP 509 -> core.quota.RateLimitError (breaker). Any 429 also -> RateLimitError. No published QPS/points. SERIALIZE pulls per connection (no parallel fan-out against one key).

error_map._note: Keys are '<http_status>:<API_Code_Category>' -- the CATEGORY PREFIX only (connector._code_prefix reduces the Piano Category_Subcode to its Category before matching, so a full-code key would be unreachable and is never declared). Piano v3 error bodies carry an API-Code string (Category_Subcode). 509 QuotasExceeded_TooManyRequests and any 429 stay on the core.quota.RateLimitError breaker path (NOT in error_map). InvalidColumns_* is the catalog-drift key (unknown Data Model property/metric) -> pull_invalid_request drift. A bare 400 with no recognised code still classifies invalid_request by pure-HTTP fallback.

discovery.v1_strategy: No documented public endpoint lists the sites an API key can reach (contrast GA4 accountSummaries.list). v1: candidate site ids are supplied to discovery (connection input), each VERIFIED by a 1-row getData access-check probe; unreachable candidates are dropped.
discovery.access_check: POST /v3/data/getData {columns:["m_visits"], space:{s:[<site_id>]}, period:{p1:[{type:R,granularity:D,startOffset:-1,endOffset:-1}]}, max-results:1} -> 200 reachable; UnauthorizedSite(403)/InvalidSpace_NoActiveSite -> not selectable.
discovery.spike: Confirm/deny a Piano management/admin API that lists sites for the key; if it exists and the same x-api-key reads it, implement true site enumeration in discover_accounts (ROLLOUT_NOTES).

_account_topology_note._no_env_vars: No *_SITE_ID account fallback in the pull path (doctrine). The selected site_id lives in the topology scope (connection_ref); discovery candidates are the only place a client-supplied id enters, and every one is access-checked.
